column1: # Seat A401: the class of every hunk that a cited range meets, read by hand (2026-10-05).

column5: note

column1: # class:  cosmetic   a rename, a field move, an object shape, a type, a stack-trace helper
#         refactor   the same exits in the same order, by the argument in the note
#         behaviour  an exit, a cause, an order, a mask or a state differs on some input
#         host       differs only at the host boundary (async context, a host function that throws)
#         api        a public name, a signature or an entry point changes; source that names it changes
# reach:  main       on an ordinary path of the modelled fragment
#         budget     only where one run-loop entry spends the operation budget
#         corner     on a named corner (the note says which)
#         outside    outside the fragment this tree models

column5: `declare` on a class field: no field initialiser is emitted; the constructor still assigns it
`causeCombine` moved to `internal/core.ts`; `Arr.union` became `dedupeReasons` (hash buckets, then `Equal.equals`): the same union in order of first occurrence, if `Hash` agrees with `Equal`
`causeSquash`: first `Fail`, else first `Die`, else an interrupt error, else an empty-cause error; the same answer by cases on the three reason tags
the cached context fields moved from the fiber into `fiber.cache`; `declare` fields; `_parent` and `_asyncContext` are new
the observer array is allocated at the first observer and handed off at the exit; observers still run once, in registration order; `removeObserver` is the old cancel closure
the fiber captures a node `AsyncResource` when it parks or starts deferred, and re-enters `evaluate` inside it; no exit and no order changes

a child is removed from its parent's set by a parent pointer, before every observer; the pin removed it in the observer registered at the fork. They differ only when an observer was registered on the child during its immediate start
the run loop reads `this.cache` once per iteration; the same three tests in the same order
`getCont` calls the frame's `contAll` through a local; the same pops and the same answer
`setContext` computes one cache object per context root; the same values, by the release's rule that contexts of one root resolve the cached keys alike (assumed, read in the comment)
`internalCall` removed: it only names a stack frame
`tryPromise` runs the catcher inside a `suspend` on the fiber, not in the promise callback: one more operation, and the catcher runs later
types only (the compiled JavaScript of the lines is equal)
the `Async` primitive is an object with named fields; the same statements in the same order, `register` still called with the scheduler as `this`

`AsyncFinalizer`: a cancel effect that fails is merged into the interrupt cause (`combineFinalizerCause`); the pin answered the cancel effect's failure alone. One more `OnFailure` frame on the interrupt path (probe R3)
`gen` picks its body before the `suspend`; the same `suspend` of `fromIteratorUnsafe`
the `Iterator` primitive is an object with named fields; the same loop
`as`, `andThen`, `tap` and `flatMap` build a `ContImpl` frame with a shared continuation; the same frames, the same operation counts (probe R4)

the new `ContImpl` continuations; `mapCont` and `succeedPayload` hand their value to `fiber.succeedWith`, which counts an operation and calls the next continuation without a loop iteration, so the budget's yield lands later (probe R5)

`raceAll` decides the clean-up of the losers at the race's exit, through an `OnExit` frame, not at the winner's resume; a loser forked while the race settles is now interrupted (probe R1). The callback has no cancel effect any more
`updateContext` pushes its `OnExit` frame directly (`onExitUnsafe`): one operation fewer (probe R4, `provideService`)
`catchCause` builds its frame with a constructor
`matchCauseEffect` builds its frame with a constructor
`match` and `matchCause` are two new primitives (`Match`, `MatchCause`) whose arms pass their value to `fiber.succeedWith`; the same operation counts (probe R4), a later budget yield
the `Exit` frame passes the reified exit to `fiber.succeedWith`; the same operation count (probe R4), a later budget yield
`timeout` fails with a `TimeoutError` that carries a message; `timeoutOrElse` is built on `timeoutOption` (probe R7)
`Scope.close` enters an uninterruptible region before the finalizers run; the pin ran them with the caller's mask (probe `closeInterruptedMidFinalizer`)
`scopeCloseUnsafe` detaches the scope from its parent as it closes; a forked scope with one finalizer now takes the lone-finalizer branch and answers that finalizer's value (probe `forkedChildOne`)
`runFinalizer`: a finalizer function that throws becomes a defect effect, so the walk goes on
`scopeForkUnsafe` links by a parent pointer and one finalizer on the parent, keyed by the child; the child holds no finalizer that removes it
`scopeAddFinalizerUnsafe` drops the branch for an open scope with no finalizer, a state that the release no longer reaches
`scopeRemoveFinalizerUnsafe` resets a scope with no finalizer left to `Empty`; the pin left it `Open` (probe `parentAfterChildClose`)
`scopeFinalizerCountUnsafe` is gone; a scope carries its `parent`
`scoped` pushes its `OnExit` frame directly: one operation fewer (probe R4)
the `OnExit` frame is an object with named fields
an `onExit` function that throws becomes a defect effect, merged as a finalizer failure
`forEach` resolves its concurrency through `resolveConcurrency`: the same number
`awaitAllChildren` awaits its children interruptibly when the fiber was interruptible; the pin awaited inside the masked finalizer (probe R2)
`declare` on class fields
`causeCombine` now lives here, over `dedupeReasons` (see internal/effect.ts hunk 4)
the stack frame is read from `fiber.cache`

the `Failure` evaluator: a failure that passes while the fiber is interrupted and interruptible loses its `Fail` reasons when it skipped a recovery handler, and always gains the interrupt reasons. This repairs U-01 (probe `backlog`)
arming falls back to a microtask when the timer call throws
`maxOpsBeforeYield` is read from `fiber.cache`
`makeUnsafe` builds the Deferred with a constructor; the same two fields
`dedupeWith` keeps the first of each class of equivalent elements, in order; the same result
the type of a memo entry: a `deferred` and a `scope` replace `effect`

the memo map counts and registers an observer in one synchronous step, installs the exit handler before it publishes an entry, and builds without an entry in a closed scope. The pin registered by an effect, so an interrupt between two steps could strand an observer or an entry
a memo hit answers the Deferred's stored effect or its await; the same effect as the pin's `entry.effect`
`takeBetween` keeps its minimum after a wait and normalises its counts (P2)
the posted wake clears `scheduleRunning` itself and skips each taker that is not ready (P2, P3)
`Scope.close` takes a `Closeable`, by type

the evaluation carries no input evidence: `orElse` does not keep it, `all` fails at the first failing member and is absent when a member is, `withDefault` fires on every absent resolution
`getScalar(node)` is inlined as `node?.value`
the constructors are renamed (`Config.string` to `Config.String`, `int` to `Int`, `boolean` to `Boolean`, `url` to `URL`); `TrueValues` and `FalseValues` are gone
`flow(transform, f)` written out

an interpolated value that holds a `$` pattern is inserted literally

`toCodecJsonReorder` moved to `internal/schema/toCodec.ts`; it sorts by priority with the engine's stable sort in place of an index tie-break: the same order. The rest of the rebuilt `toCodecJson` was not read
`Union` takes no mode argument; the mode lives in an options record
